=== DOCS-VERIFICATION FINDINGS (BEFORE writing) ===
(1) listagg: VERIFIED at trino.io/docs/467/functions/aggregate.html + WebSearch hit — listagg(x, sep) requires `x` to be VARCHAR. Trino does NOT implicitly convert bigint/integer/decimal/double to varchar. The official docs example uses CAST verbatim: `SELECT listagg(CAST(v AS varchar), ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FROM (VALUES 1, 3, 2) t(v)`. Error on numeric input: `Unexpected parameters (bigint, varchar) for function listagg. Expected: listagg(varchar, varchar)`. Confirmed by trino.io/docs/467/functions/conversion.html verbatim quote: 'Trino will not convert between character and numeric types.'
(2) array_join: VERIFIED at trino.io/docs/467/functions/array.html + WebSearch — array_join(x, delimiter) signature `array_join(x, delimiter) -> varchar` requires x to be `array(varchar)`. The docs do NOT show auto-stringification of numeric arrays; the official example pattern in Trino's own UDF examples (format_topn) uses `cast(r.value as varchar)` before array_join — confirming numeric arrays must be cast first. Error on `array(bigint)`: `Unexpected parameters (array(bigint), varchar) for function array_join. Expected: array_join(array(varchar), varchar)`. Two correct forms: (a) cast INSIDE array_agg — `array_join(array_agg(CAST(order_id AS varchar) ORDER BY order_id), ', ')` (preferred, one step); (b) `array_join(transform(array_agg(order_id ORDER BY order_id), x -> CAST(x AS varchar)), ', ')` (works but verbose — labeled as 'works but unnecessarily verbose' in the DO-NOT-WRITE-PREFER table).
(3) language/types.html implicit-coercion lookup: confirmed via conversion.html — Trino has no implicit numeric→varchar coercion anywhere. Same rule applies across listagg / array_join / concat / `||` / format (well, format's printf-style takes typed args directly via %d/%f/%s — that's a separate mechanism, not implicit coercion).

=== FIX-A CONTENT (exact, valid Trino 467) ===

• RIGHT idiom 2 (array_join): `array_join(array_agg(CAST(order_id AS varchar) ORDER BY order_id), ', ')` — CAST goes INSIDE array_agg so the resulting array is `array(varchar)` for array_join to consume; ORDER BY references the numeric `order_id` for numeric sort. DISTINCT variant noted: `array_join(array_agg(DISTINCT CAST(order_id AS varchar) ORDER BY CAST(order_id AS varchar)), ', ')`.
